functionName.description: signature.function in this language's naming convention.

starter.description: Plain-text editor contents, indented with indentUnit.

indentUnit.description: Indentation for this language, e.g. four spaces for Python. Use as the editor indent unit.

topics.description: Additional topics besides category. Unknown topics are created.

starters.description: Optional per-language starter overrides keyed by language. Merged by key on update.

TypeName.description: Language-agnostic type every runner implements. ListNode is encoded as an array of values; TreeNode as a level-order array with nulls.

function.description: Canonical camelCase name; languages apply their own naming convention.

returns.description: A TypeName, or void when the solution only changes output.

output.description: Parameter changed in place and checked after the call. With a void return the whole parameter is the answer; with an int return k, its first k items are. Required for void returns.

Compare.description: How a returned value is checked. unordered compares array returns as multisets.

TestKind.description: Examples are shown in the statement; hidden tests are never returned.
